town_description: Ludhiana is Punjab's largest industrial city, set on the Grand Trunk Road along the old course of the Sutlej. It is a predominantly Sikh city with major gurdwaras (notably Dukh Niwaran Sahib at Field Ganj) alongside Hindu temples, and Namdhari (Kuka) Sikh heritage sites in its vicinity (Sri Bhaini Sahib is nearby).
tradition: Unconfirmed (possibly Sikh - verify; not confirmed as a Hindu temple)

travel.airport: Sahnewal Airport (Ludhiana) has limited service (verify); the nearest major airport is Sri Guru Ram Das Ji International Airport, Amritsar (~135 km) or Chandigarh (~100 km).
travel.railway: Ludhiana Junction is a major station on the Delhi-Amritsar line.
travel.road: On NH-44 (Grand Trunk Road); well connected to Jalandhar (60 km), Amritsar (135 km) and Chandigarh (100 km).
